## Summary and linked issue

What changes for the user or maintainer? Link the issue or design when available.

## Risk and scope

Which subsystems and guides are affected? Call out changes to contracts, runtime, or frontend hooks.

## Verification evidence

- [ ] Static and unit checks — record the command and result.
- [ ] Execution evidence — link a CI run, CLI output, or UI capture for the changed behavior.
- [ ] Skipped checks — list each check and its reason, or write “none”.

## How to revert

State whether reverting the commit suffices and list any configuration or state recovery steps.
